Description
One of the most established and well-known producers in the global bullion market created this 1 Kilo Metalor Silver Bar Fine. Investors frequently seek out distinctive and reliable goods when purchasing silver. The Metalor Group’s refining sector prioritizes environmental concerns while upholding a reputation for Swiss-quality services and goods. This Metalor 1 kilo Silver Bar, which contains 99.99% pure silver, will be a valuable addition to any expanding precious metals portfolio.
In 1852, Métaux Précieux SA Metalor, now known as
The Metalor Group
, was established in Switzerland. They provided gold components to nearby watch manufacturing companies. In 1864, the refinery partnered with a nearby bank, increasing its offerings to include bullion for the banking sector.
When the Swiss Bank Corporation bought the business in 1918, the corporation finally got its first name on paper. The Tanaka Kikinzoku Group acquired the Métaux Précieux in 2016—nearly 100 years after it was founded. Through this transaction, Metalor gained international exposure and the current Metalor Group was created. Metalor has remained a significant provider of products made from precious metals around the globe.
Design of Metalor 1 Kilo Silver Bar
1 kilo Metalor silver bar includes inscriptions that are positioned vertically down the field in portrait orientation.
The silver bars
are marked with the METALOR insignia at the top and the weight, purity, and metal content below. A little below is engraved the name SWITZERLAND and below that at the bottom of the field a unique serial number.
The 1 kilo .999 metalor silver bar reverse side is left blank. Writing typically appears on only one face of silver cast bars. You might find different natural striations and other textures on the reverse field. Please be informed that cast silver bars could have minor imperfections; nevertheless, this is not a guarantee. Unlike coined ingots, cast silver bars are not polished after production.

Contains 1 Kilo of .9999 fine silver
Silver Cast Bar
Individually serialized
Manufactured by the Metalor Group
